title: Get Trailhead ready for GitHub Pages
remaining: Prepare this project to go live on GitHub Pages, which builds it from this GitHub repo itself. Add a GitHub Actions workflow that, on each push to the default branch, builds the site (plain HTML needs no build: publish its folder as it is) and publishes it with actions/upload-pages-artifact and actions/deploy-pages (free on public repos). Make links and asset paths work under the repo's own path (https://<owner>.github.io/<repo>/). So Retaskable can tell when a change is live, make the live site answer /version.json, at the root it is served from, with {"sha":"<commit>"}: the commit it was built from, written during the build from the GITHUB_SHA variable GitHub Pages sets (else git rev-parse HEAD), and never cached (Cache-Control: no-store where the host allows it). Never deploy, and never add a token, password or secret to the repo.
